messages:
maria: FYI Everwell just uploaded RFP_v2 — they tightened data residency and added an HSM requirement. Need: capability matrix, security questionnaire, pricing appendix, and a POC plan. Deadline: next Friday. Link: https://drive.google.com/everwell/rfp_v2

 tom: Got it. Do they want committed QPS or a cost-per-token model for the POC? Any preferred billing anchor (region/EU-only)?

 devin: I can own the capability matrix and competitor mapping. Will export CSV for their template. Can someone confirm hard blockers?

 anika: Security side — they want KMS with customer-controlled keys (HSM-backed), SOC2 + ISO27001 evidence, and network isolation (EU VPC). Also want an audit-log sample and encryption-in-transit details. I'll start the questionnaire.

 salesbot: Reminder: standard RFI template at /assets/rfi-templates/rfi_template_v3.xlsx — attach when ready.

 maria: POC ask from their infra team: 3-week integration test, 2-week perf/scale run. They may ask for a short on-prem connector proof for an air-gapped eval. We should propose timeline but call out additional lead time for HSM.

 devin: Proposed POC schedule (high level):
```
Week 0: Kickoff + network connectivity & DPA sign-off
Week 1: Infra provisioning (VPC peering, peering routes, KMS setup)
Week 2: Integration tests + sample traffic
Week 3: Perf runs + latency/cost profiling
Week 4: Wrap-up & handoff (optional extension for compliance tests)
```
I uploaded a draft matrix: https://sheets.redwood/everwell-capability-matrix (tab: matrix + attachments). Competitor callouts included (CloudAI lat/kv-cache notes).

 tom: Pricing sketch for POC — keep conservative and mark as 'estimate':
```
Hosted API (POC): $0.0008 / token (generation)
Embeddings: $0.002 per 1k embed units
Dedicated (reserved pool): $8,500 / month (1x A100 equivalent) + metered tokens thereafter
```
Callout: EU-only region surcharge +10% if they require isolated EU compute.

 anika: I'll need the control mappings for SOC2 items (CC6, CC7 etc.). Devin, can you attach sample architecture diagram showing KMS + HSM flow? Also supply a sample audit-log extract (redacted).

 devin: I'll attach the arch diagram and a redacted audit log snippet to the sheet by EOD. For HSM — we support HSM-backed KMS via our private offering; note that on-prem HSM requires a brokered setup and extra legal review.

 maria: Owners: devin = capability matrix & attachments, anika = security questionnaire answers, tom = pricing appendix & commercial note. I'll coordinate legal and draft the cover email.

 tom: I'll also draft two options: (A) Hosted + EU tenancy w/ KMS BYOK, (B) Dedicated private deployment (reserved) with HSM broker. That way they can choose capex vs opex.

 salesbot: Deadline reminder set: RFP response due 2025-08-01 17:00 UTC.

 sec-bot: Security checklist state: questionnaire in progress (anika). Outstanding items: HSM architecture diagram, audit-log sample, KMS SLA doc, certificate of insurance.

 maria: Great progress. Next sync tomorrow 10:00am PT — I'll post a consolidated deliverables checklist in the thread before then. If you hit blockers, @maria DM. :thumbsup:
